title: Godot silent crashes randomly to the point that it's unusable.
body:
### Tested versions

Reproduceable in any version of Godot that I've downloaded onto my machine which tells me the problem is with my computer I think.
The versions I've tried are 3.6 Stable, 4.3 Stable, 4.4.1 stable, 4.4 Stable, 4.5.1 Stable and 4.6.1 stable. It has also been reproduceable in the Steam version of Godot.

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9571) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900K (24 threads) - 63.72 GiB memory

### Issue description

Let me start this off by saying that I have been researching and ripping my hair out over this issue since the release of 4.4.1. I understand that the problem is with my machine specifically (at least that's what I think) and any leads or information that I find online doesn't quite match my symptoms. The problem seems to occur anytime that I'm working in forward + rendering mode, this seems to be the only consistency that I can find but I'm not sure what it's pointing to other than a Vulkan rendering incompatibility that I don't know how to find. The Godot engine will run anywhere from10 seconds to 3 hours before silently crashing like I've pressed close. I get no error messages or debug output and when running in verbose mode the only indication that i get as to the fact that it has crashed is the standard XR closing messages. The symptoms seem to persist only on my PC as other PC's in the house running the same projects do not have this issue and I'm to the point of wiping my hard drives and re-installing windows because that's the only thing I haven't tried yet. Attached is the verbose debug file that I have obtained from a recent crash in 4.6.1 Stable. 

[Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 11.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25700706/Godot.v4.6.1.stable.-.Windows.11.txt)

### Steps to reproduce

Open Godot Launcher.
Open any project.
Wait.
So far these seem to be the only steps really needed to reproduce the issue on my machine.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
Happens in any project I open.
